results.title: Brazil: Lula celebrates 81st birthday after re-election victory
results.content: Brazil's re-elected President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva celebrated his 81st birthday on Tuesday, 27 October, with dozens of supporters outside the Alvorada presidential palace in Brasília, just two days after winning a closely contested election.

results.title: Ukraine: massive fire engulfs buildings after Russian strike on Kharkiv
results.content: Five people, including a 4-year-old child, were injured in an overnight Russian drone strike on Kharkiv. The attack set several buildings ablaze, with firefighters working under the threat of further strikes.

results.title: Europe Today: Israel faces deadlock after vote, Nordic leaders hold rare Putin call
results.content: Israel's election has ended in apparent deadlock, with neither Benjamin Netanyahu nor Gadi Eisenkot on track for a majority. Finland's and Norway's leaders have phoned Vladimir Putin as Europe seeks a seat at the table. We also cover Serbia's vote, the upcoming US midterms, and Mbappé's China row.

results.title: South Africa tests 7.6-kilometre freight train in bid to break world record
results.content: South Africa's state-owned logistics company Transnet says it has tested the world's longest freight train. Measuring 7.6 kilometres and made up of 696 empty wagons, the train travelled 860 kilometres from Saldanha Bay to an inland iron ore mine.

results.content: Cyclone Arnab strengthened into a “very severe” cyclonic storm late Tuesday with gusting winds and heavy rain reported in several coastal areas.

results.title: Israel: opposition supporters celebrate narrow lead in exit polls
results.content: Supporters of Gadi Eisenkot celebrated in Tel Aviv as exit polls gave Israel's opposition bloc a narrow lead over Benjamin Netanyahu's camp, but no outright parliamentary majority.

results.title: Portugal: Lisbon housing crisis sparks protest outside parliament
results.content: Demonstrators gathered outside Portugal's parliament to protest against the housing crisis and police violence during recent camp clearances. The president has called for dialogue while defending police actions.

results.title: Israel election: Netanyahu bloc leads with more than half of votes counted but short of majority
results.content: The partial results are likely to change, and several exit polls showed the camps neck-and-neck without a majority.

results.title: Egypt’s parliament approves military support for Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks
results.content: Egypt has approved military help for Saudi Arabia if requested as Houthi attacks threaten the kingdom and Red Sea shipping. The vote comes as Saudi officials hold talks in Iran amid regional efforts to prevent a further escalation of the fighting.

results.title: Qatar urges Iran to 'show goodwill' by ending threats to the region and reopening the Strait of Hormuz
results.content: Regional powers are seeking a way out of the Iran war as attacks threaten shipping and energy supplies. Qatar says mediation continues after a visit to Tehran, where Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey have also held talks with Iranian leaders.

results.title: South Africa: Athlete traverses 600 monkey bars under a 216-metre bridge
results.content: Suspended beneath South Africa's 216-metre-high Bloukrans Bridge, Thomas van Tonder crossed 600 monkey bars over more than 280 metres, completing the challenge in 47 minutes and 37 seconds.

results.title: Flávio Bolsonaro reportedly leaves Brazil for US after election defeat
results.content: A police source told the AFP news agency that Bolsonaro's passports had been "cancelled" and that there was "no formal record" of him leaving the country.

results.title: Myanmar: spectacular lantern festival lights up ancient temples in Bagan
results.content: Hundreds of glowing lanterns floated into the night sky above Bagan's ancient pagodas. Thousands gathered to celebrate Thadingyut, Myanmar's Festival of Lights marking the end of Buddhist Lent.

results.title: 'Unacceptable violation': Syria condemns Jordan airstrikes
results.content: A government spokesperson said Jordan had "avoided" civilian sites and that it regretted "unintended casualties," stressing that the country had "deep respect" for the Syrian state and people.

results.title: Italian archaeologists discover links to tomb of Jesus underneath Jerusalem's Church of the Holy Sepulchre
results.content: Italian researchers have found a burial ground beneath Jerusalem's Church of the Holy Sepulchre, matching biblical accounts of the location of Jesus' burial.

results.content: At least four workers died when a tornado struck a construction site in Antalya, overturning accommodation cabins and a tower crane. Heavy rain also flooded roads in Istanbul.

results.content: A Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv killed one person and injured 15. Emergency workers rescued a dog from the rubble, while strikes damaged university buildings and a major bridge.

results.content: With no party expected to win an outright majority, weeks of coalition talks could follow a vote being closely watched in European capitals.

results.content: The German chancellor's upbeat pitch comes at a time of mounting pressure in Berlin, where a ministerial resignation and rising far-right support have left the chancellor’s coalition on shaky ground.

results.title: France: crowds fill Marseille's Old Port in anti-racism protest
results.content: Hundreds of people gathered at Marseille's Vieux-Port on Monday evening to protest against racism following a deadly shooting near Paris. Police estimated the crowd at 800, while organisers put attendance at more than 1,000.

results.title: María Corina Machado seeks talks with Delcy Rodríguez after return from exile
results.content: After a year in exile, Venezuela's opposition leader returns, ready to negotiate with the government. The EU welcomes her and calls for free and fair elections.

results.title: Pope Leo XIV confirms Latin America trip after recovering from surgery
results.content: The Vatican says the Pope is recovering well and will be able to visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru from 6 to 17 November, with doctors ruling out any complications that could derail the trip.
